userRequest.Scope: Eliminate the remaining 1-pixel oscillation on upper-half text and glyphs (tiles, clock, date) during 60 Hz hover transitions and per-second clock repaints at 150% DPI.

change.FixedOriginOffscreenD2DCanvas: Proved why only the upper half above ruleY=252 shook: lower-half metric rows sit at even DIPs (14, 56, 264, 286... -> exact .0 physical pixels at 1.5x DPI), whereas upper-half tile/clock/date labels sit at odd DIPs (x=51->76.5 px, x=191->286.5 px, y=65->97.5 px, y=115->172.5 px, y=5->7.5 px, y=9->13.5 px). DirectComposition's shared texture atlas ping-pongs ICompositionDrawingSurfaceInterop::BeginDraw offsets between even (0) and odd (451/645) pixels across frames, causing DirectWrite's IEEE-754 round-half-to-even pixel snapping to alternate 76<->77 and 98<->97 on every repaint. Drawing::Redraw in aggregate/drawing-latest.h now renders at a fixed (0, 0) identity origin on a persistent device-shared ID2D1Bitmap1 canvas via scratchDc and copies 1:1 in integer pixels (D2D1_UNIT_MODE_PIXELS + D2D1_PRIMITIVE_BLEND_COPY + NEAREST_NEIGHBOR) into BeginDraw's atlas slot.
